gemini.title: Urban Areas Boundary
gemini.abstract: Urban Areas Boundary is an authoritative dataset published by Central Statistics Office Ireland. It represents urban areas boundary features using geometry geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Central Statistics Office Ireland as open statistics and census data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: urban_area_code
columns.description: Code assigned by the source dataset.

columns.name: urban_area_name
columns.description: Name associated with the represented feature.

columns.name: county
columns.description: County associated with the represented administrative area.

columns.name: centroid_x
columns.description: X coordinate of the feature centroid; units and reference system are not confirmed for this attribute.

columns.name: centroid_y
columns.description: Y coordinate of the feature centroid; units and reference system are not confirmed for this attribute.

columns.name: objectid
columns.description: Source-system row identifier; useful internally but not guaranteed to remain stable between data releases.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.
